criteria_results.text: Starting the isolated sandbox must leave the live :4096 and :4001 listener PIDs unchanged.
criteria_results.notes: Live :4096 remained PID 4099 and live :4001 remained PID 4089 before and after sandbox startup.

criteria_results.text: The sandbox API on :4098 and its Opencode health endpoint must become healthy while the engine listens on :4097.
criteria_results.notes: :4098 /health returned status ok, :4098/opencode/health returned status ready, :4097 listened on PID 51478, and copied scheduled tasks enabled count was zero.

criteria_results.text: Stopping the sandbox must free :4097/:4098, remove the sandbox directory, and preserve live services.
criteria_results.notes: After sandbox.sh down, :4097/:4098 had no listeners, the sandbox directory was absent, and live :4096/:4001 PIDs and health were unchanged.

process_issues.description: The host command shell selected unsupported Node 26 (ABI 147) while better-sqlite3 was built for supported Node 22 (ABI 127); the first launch failed before binding :4098.
process_issues.detected_by: api_server.log reported NODE_MODULE_VERSION 127 versus required 147; package.json declares Node >=20 <25. The lifecycle passed after selecting the existing Node 22 login-shell runtime.

process_issues.description: The previously authorized process cleanup left a stale sandbox PID file and directory, so the first up command correctly refused to proceed.
process_issues.detected_by: sandbox.sh up reported an existing api_server.pid while status showed both sandbox ports free; sandbox.sh down safely removed the stale directory before retry.

suggested_follow_up: Run sandbox lifecycle verification under the repository-supported Node 22 login-shell runtime and remove stale sandbox state before launch.
